name: ob2h-plugins
description: Plugins for ob2h (OmnesBot to Harness): long-term memory, knowledge graph and AST code graph for AI agents.

plugins.name: ob2h
plugins.description: Long-term memory, knowledge graph and AST code graph for coding agents: a local MCP server with 57 tools to recall past decisions, save new facts, analyze project architecture and estimate refactor blast radius. Data stays on your machine.

description_i18n.en: Long-term memory, knowledge graph and AST code graph for coding agents: a local MCP server with 57 tools to recall past decisions, save new facts, analyze project architecture and estimate refactor blast radius. Data stays on your machine.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为编程智能体提供长期记忆、知识图谱与 AST 代码图谱：本地 MCP 服务器，包含 57 个工具，用于回忆过往决策、保存新事实、分析项目架构并评估重构影响范围。数据保存在你的本机。
